meaning:
1) (Qal) to shake, tremble, quake
1a) (Niphal) to shake, quake

elsewhere.note: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
Therefore Yahweh says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be…
All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, Yahweh, and see; for I have become despised.”
